title: CAMELLIA: BENCHMARKING CULTURAL BIASES IN LLMS FOR ASIAN LANGUAGES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating entity-centric cultural biases by measuring LLM likelihood preferences (Cultural Bias Score) for Western versus Asian entities in masked contexts, analyzing sentiment association differences (false positive/negative rates) when substituting cultural entities in prompts, and comparing model accuracy in extracting Asian versus Western entities from paragraph-long contexts.
